Commonwealth of Australia Constitution Act

51  Legislative powers of the Parliament
The Parliament shall have power to make laws with respect to:
  (xx)  foreign corporations, and trading or financial corporations;

109  Inconsistency of laws
When a law of a State is inconsistent with a law of the Commonwealth, the latter shall prevail.

MASON CJ, BRENNAN J

1. The plaintiffs claim native title.

2. Under s 109 of the Constitution the Commonwealth law prevails; see [1988] HCA 69.
